title: Dynamic evolution of metal structures on/in zeolites for catalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00035A, Review Article
Yuexin Wu, Pengcheng Deng, Lujie Liu, Junyi Zhang, Haisheng Liu, Xionghou Gao, Feng-Shou Xiao, Liang Wang
This review explores metal migration dynamics on/in zeolite supports, analyzing mechanisms and driving factors under varied conditions. It highlights the crucial role of zeolite in stabilizing metals and enhancing performances.
